en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet lakeside or coastal village scene. In the left foreground is a wooden boathouse or shed built on the water's edge, with nets or fish hanging from its exterior. Several wooden rowing and sailing boats are moored near the shore and along the tree‑lined bank. The opposite shore and small rocky islets are visible in the distance. The caption "Hangö by" is printed in the upper right corner.
